en.title: Every company has documentation. Few have training made from it
en.description: Turning a runbook into onboarding is a project of its own, and the hardest part is keeping it current. A 22-second look at the idea.

video.caption: In the clip: a sample incident runbook (escalate after 10 minutes), the course built from it, the Escalate lesson, and a question whose correct answer comes from that sentence. The course is an unpublished draft.

pl.description: Zamiana runbooka w onboarding to osobny projekt, a najtrudniej jest utrzymać go w aktualności. 22 sekundy o tym pomyśle.
